controls.name: Risk Analysis
controls.description: Conduct an accurate and thorough assessment of the potential risks and vulnerabilities to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of electronic protected health information held by the covered entity or business associate.

points_of_focus.description: All ePHI locations are in scope
Risks and vulnerabilities are identified and rated

controls.name: Risk Management
controls.description: Implement security measures sufficient to reduce risks and vulnerabilities to a reasonable and appropriate level.

controls.name: Information System Activity Review
controls.description: Implement procedures to regularly review records of information system activity, such as audit logs, access reports, and security incident tracking reports.

controls.name: Authorization and Supervision
controls.description: Implement procedures for the authorization and/or supervision of workforce members who work with electronic protected health information or in locations where it might be accessed.

points_of_focus.description: Access is authorized before it is granted

controls.name: Termination Procedures
controls.description: Implement procedures for terminating access to electronic protected health information when the employment of, or other arrangement with, a workforce member ends.

controls.name: Access Authorization
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures for granting access to electronic protected health information, for example, through access to a workstation, transaction, program, process, or other mechanism.

controls.name: Access Establishment and Modification
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures that, based upon the entity's access authorization policies, establish, document, review, and modify a user's right of access to a workstation, transaction, program, or process.

controls.name: Protection from Malicious Software
controls.description: Procedures for guarding against, detecting, and reporting malicious software.
controls.domain: Administrative Safeguards — Security Awareness and Training

points_of_focus.description: Detection is reported and acted on

controls.name: Log-in Monitoring
controls.description: Procedures for monitoring log-in attempts and reporting discrepancies.
controls.domain: Administrative Safeguards — Security Awareness and Training

controls.name: Response and Reporting
controls.description: Identify and respond to suspected or known security incidents; mitigate, to the extent practicable, harmful effects of security incidents that are known to the covered entity or business associate; and document security incidents and their outcomes.

points_of_focus.description: Incidents are identified and responded to

controls.name: Data Backup Plan
controls.description: Establish and implement procedures to create and maintain retrievable exact copies of electronic protected health information.

controls.name: Disaster Recovery Plan
controls.description: Establish and implement procedures to restore any loss of data.

controls.name: Evaluation
controls.description: Perform a periodic technical and nontechnical evaluation, based initially upon the standards implemented under this rule and, subsequently, in response to environmental or operational changes affecting the security of electronic protected health information.

controls.name: Business Associate Contracts
controls.description: A covered entity may permit a business associate to create, receive, maintain, or transmit electronic protected health information on the covered entity's behalf only if satisfactory assurances are obtained.

controls.name: Facility Access Controls
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to limit physical access to electronic information systems and the facilities in which they are housed, while ensuring that properly authorized access is allowed.

points_of_focus.description: Physical access is limited and authorized

controls.name: Media Disposal
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to address the final disposition of electronic protected health information, and/or the hardware or electronic media on which it is stored.
controls.domain: Physical Safeguards — Device and Media Controls

controls.name: Access Control
controls.description: Implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information systems that maintain electronic protected health information to allow access only to those persons or software programs that have been granted access rights.

points_of_focus.description: Automatic logoff and encryption are addressed

controls.name: Audit Controls
controls.description: Implement hardware, software, and/or procedural mechanisms that record and examine activity in information systems that contain or use electronic protected health information.

controls.name: Integrity
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to protect electronic protected health information from improper alteration or destruction.

controls.name: Person or Entity Authentication
controls.description: Implement procedures to verify that a person or entity seeking access to electronic protected health information is the one claimed.

points_of_focus.description: Multi-factor authentication is used where appropriate

controls.name: Transmission Security
controls.description: Implement technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to electronic protected health information that is being transmitted over an electronic communications network.

points_of_focus.description: Integrity of transmitted data is protected

controls.name: Policies and Procedures
controls.description: Implement reasonable and appropriate policies and procedures to comply with the standards, implementation specifications, or other requirements of this subpart.

controls.name: Documentation Retention
controls.description: Retain the documentation required by this subpart for six years from the date of its creation or the date when it last was in effect, whichever is later.

points_of_focus.description: Retention period is defined as six years
